featured_reviews.name: Parv Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a terrible experience watching Project Hail Mary in Screen 2 of this theater.

Seats are comfortable, but the hall had a sweaty smell, it was probably the AC/ventilation not working properly.

The film started playing with the lights turned ON inside the hall. It was only after 5-10 minutes into the film that the lights were turned off. And then the film was restarted.

Since Project Hail Mary has multiple aspect ratios you can expect pillarboxing (black sides) coming and going as the scenes change during the film. But what you don't want is an uncalibrated projector scaling on the screen - a small gap in the top and bottom of the screen, which never goes away because the projector is not set up properly.

Speaking of which, the image rendering is good, I could see the grains too, but the focus was just a bit off. Moreover, the screen was dirty in the center right with a huge mark. Looked like someone tried to clean but accidentally smeared. It blackened the projection in that spot.

The audio was average, but the center channel had a constant loud buzzing. Which was a major distraction in the experience of the film.

Overall it felt like watching a pirated copy of the film in some second-hand theater setup. Definitely not satisfactory or worth the time. The ticket prices were INR 91/- so I felt like they deliberately choose the worse performing screen (Screen 2).

I believe that Miraj Cinemas can do so much better. Not everyone wants to watch Dhurandhar, so please take good care of ALL of your customers.

Audio: 4/10
Video: 5/10
Ticket price: Rs. 91 (the experience shouldn't reflect that)

featured_reviews.name: Prasad Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Screen & Picture Quality
The visual experience here is consistently good. The screens are well-calibrated, bright, and deliver sharp picture quality with excellent contrast. Whether you are catching a massive visual-effects blockbuster or a regional drama, the projection clarity makes the experience highly engaging. The screen sizing relative to the seating arrangement is well-proportioned, ensuring a great view from almost any row.
The Seats
Comfort is a huge plus at this property. The seats are ergonomically designed, spacious, and provide good cushioning and back support, which is essential for sitting through a long three-hour movie. The legroom between rows is quite generous, meaning you don't feel cramped, and people can pass by without making you awkwardly tuck your legs in. If you want to elevate the experience, their premium/recliner seating options are definitely worth the upgrade.
The Sound Quality
The theater features an impressive surround sound setup (including Dolby Atmos capabilities in select audi screens). The audio layout is powerful, crisp, and clean. The dialogue clarity is sharp, and the bass response has a fantastic punch to it without being overwhelmingly loud or distorted. It completely immerses you in the movie's background score and action sequences.
Overall Hygiene
Hygiene and cleanliness are clearly a top priority for the management here.
• The Audi: The theater hall itself is clean, free of litter, and lacks any of the damp or stale odors sometimes found in older multiplexes.
• The Washrooms: The restrooms are highly maintained, frequently cleaned, and well-stocked with soap and paper towels.
• The Lobby: The common areas and food counters are kept immaculate and tidy, creating an inviting and premium environment from the moment you walk in.
The Verdict
INOX at Korum Mall remains one of the best and most reliable spots in Thane to enjoy a movie. Thanks to its comfortable seating, crisp sound, excellent screen quality, and top-tier hygiene, it guarantees a hassle-free and premium cinematic outing. Highly recommended for families and friends alike!

featured_reviews.name: Deep Rajgor
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

NY Cinemas Mulund is one of the better theatres compared to many others I’ve visited. The best part is the location – just a 2-minute walk from Mulund railway station, which makes it very convenient.

🎬 My Experience:
I’ve watched many films here – Pushpa, Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3, Chandu Champion, Dunki, and more. Every time, the experience has been quite good overall.

🛋️ Seats:
The seats are very comfortable and better than most nearby theatres. Sitting through a 2.5 to 3-hour movie feels easy and relaxed.

❄️ AC (Important Point):
This is the same issue I’ve noticed in almost every theatre nowadays – the AC is not as strong or consistent as before. Back in the 2000–2017 era, theatres used to keep the cooling so high that people carried jackets just to watch movies. In fact, some people even bought tickets only to sleep in the theatre because the AC was so powerful! Now, that unique theatre “chill” experience is gone. The AC here is okay, but not at the superior level it once used to be.

Also, ticket prices have increased a lot. Sometimes, when another theatre is charging ₹130, here it may go up to ₹200. With higher prices, at least the AC should be maintained well.

🔊 Sound & Screen:
The sound quality is balanced with new technology – dialogues are clear, music and effects are impactful without being too loud. The screen size is medium – not too big, not too small – just right for a good movie outing.

👋 Staff & Entry:
The staff are professional, though unlike some theatres (like Miraj), I didn’t notice greetings like “Good Evening” at the entry. Small gestures like that add a nice human touch, but it’s fine.

⏳ Waiting Area:
If you arrive too early, there isn’t much waiting or seating space outside the halls. Better to come on time, as space is limited.

✅ Overall:
A reliable theatre near Mulund station with comfortable seats, decent AC (though not as great as the old days), good sound, and medium-sized screen. Convenient for regular movie-goers like me and definitely better than a lot of nearby options.

featured_reviews.name: JITENDRA MALUSARE
featured_reviews.review_text:
Watched "Dhurandhar - The Revenge"movie at Cinépolis Viviana Mall in IMAX 2D and overall it was a solid cinematic experience, especially for people around Thane.

The IMAX screen is definitely larger than standard screens and gives a more immersive feel, especially for action and visually rich movies. The seating angle and screen curvature help you stay engaged throughout the film. However, compared to newer IMAX formats in Mumbai, the brightness and sharpness feel slightly limited at times.
The Dolby Atmos sound is one of the stronger aspects here — dialogues are clear and background effects are well distributed, making scenes feel more dynamic and engaging. That said, in some moments the balance could feel a bit inconsistent depending on the auditorium.

The multiplex itself is quite advanced, with multiple formats like IMAX, 4DX, and Atmos under one roof, making it one of the more technologically equipped cinemas in the region.

Cleanliness, lobby ambience, and overall maintenance are good, and the location inside Viviana Mall makes it convenient for combining movies with shopping or food plans.

Overall, a very good option for IMAX experience in Thane without traveling far — just don’t expect the absolute top-tier IMAX quality available in newer upgraded theatres.

featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are looking for an affordable movie outing in Thane, Cinepolis at High Street Mall has a lot going for it on paper, but my recent visit left us with a rather mixed impression.
​Let's start with the positives, because the core cinematic experience is actually quite strong. The audio-visual quality is fantastic. The sound system is crisp, clear, and perfectly balanced, giving you that immersive theatrical feel you want. Additionally, the seating is incredibly comfortable. The chairs offer great support with plenty of room, making it easy to relax through a long film. Another major advantage is the pricing. In a time when multiplex tickets can be exceptionally high, this theater remains very much under budget, offering great value for your money. They also maintain a solid variety of food and beverage options at the concession stands, so all your snack cravings are covered.
​However, all these great features are significantly overshadowed by one unavoidable issue: a persistent, unpleasant smell. This isn't just an isolated incident in a bathroom. The strange odor is noticeable as soon as you walk inside the mall itself, it follows you right into the movie theater auditorium, and it still heavily lingers in the exit corridors as you leave. My wife found the smell particularly off-putting, and it genuinely detracted from the enjoyment of our evening. It is incredibly distracting to try and focus on a film while dealing with poor air quality in a closed space.
​Overall, while I appreciate the comfortable seats, excellent sound, and budget-friendly tickets, the facility's ambiance is a major letdown. The management urgently needs to look into their ventilation and cleaning protocols to eliminate this odor. Once the smell is addressed, this could easily be a five-star location.

Your concern has been shared with the concerned team for immediate inspection of ventilation and housekeeping measures to ensure a more comfortable experience for our guests.

featured_reviews.name: Govind Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is an okay place to watch movies, especially if you live nearby. It’s a 5-screen multiplex, so you usually get multiple movie options. The ambience inside the theatre is good, and the place is generally neat and well maintained. The theatre is located on the 3rd floor, and paid parking is available in the mall basement, which is convenient.
Coming to the movie experience—sound quality is decent to good (in some screens it’s actually very good), but the screen size and picture quality are a letdown, especially in the smaller screens. The visuals appear dull, dark, and slightly blackish, which affects the overall viewing experience. While they advertise premium sound formats, the actual experience feels mediocre, except for sound in certain shows.
The seating experience is mixed. VIP seats are nice and comfortable, but the regular seats are quite uncomfortable and can cause back pain during longer movies. This seriously impacts the enjoyment of the film.
The mall itself feels outdated and more like a trade centre now. Escalators often don’t work, lifts are usually crowded, and route guidance inside the mall is poor, causing confusion—especially for first-time visitors. Cleanliness and parking management could also be improved, as help is rarely available.
Food options are available but priced higher than expected compared to ticket value, and the air conditioning could be better. Staff inside the theatre is supportive, though there were occasional issues like digital payment portals not working during night shows.
Overall, it’s a decent option for a casual movie outing with family, mainly due to location convenience. However, screen quality, seating comfort, mall approach, and maintenance need major improvement.
Average experience—3 stars.

Even the staff are incredibly polite and well-trained—they actually guide you to your seats with a smile, which instantly sets a great vibe for the night.
​As for the movie itself? Absolutely magnificent quality. I tried their Prime Sensory seats, and they have this crazy Buttkicker technology where the seats actually vibrate with the bass of the movie. Pair that with the crystal-clear screen and the insane Dolby Atmos surround sound, and you are completely glued to the action. The recliners are pure luxury, and a huge plus is that the movie actually started right on time without 20 minutes of annoying ads.
​Now, be prepared because it is definitely high in cost. The food menu is total gourmet status, but paying around ₹300 for delicious nachos or splurging on their premium popcorn definitely hurts the wallet a bit. Still, for a special date night or when you just want a fantabulous, premium movie experience right here at The Walk, it is worth every single rupee. I’m definitely coming back!

Hiranandani Estate has finally received the cinematic upgrade it deserves! For those of us living along Ghodbunder Road, the opening of Devgan Cinema at The Walk is a game-changer. It effectively ends the need to battle traffic and travel all the way to the older parts of Thane for a premium movie experience.
From the moment you step into the lobby, the "reach" vibes are unmistakable. The theater is incredibly spacious and defines ultra-luxury. The interior design feels modern and sophisticated, making it the ultimate destination for a high-end night out.
The technical specifications are equally impressive. The picture quality is crystal clear, and the sound system is powerful and immersive, ensuring every frame feels larger than life. Comfort hasn't been overlooked either; the chairs are super comfortable, providing ample support for even the longest blockbusters.
A standout feature for EV owners is the convenience of the parking facilities. Having both 2 and 4-wheeler charging stations available right in the parking lot is a brilliant touch. You can simply plug in your vehicle, head up to enjoy your movie, and return to a fully charged car—it's seamless living at its best.
While the tickets and food are a little costly, it is clearly priced for the luxury experience being provided. If you are looking for top-tier comfort and a premium atmosphere, it is worth every rupee. Highly recommended—you should definitely explore this new gem in Thane!

featured_reviews.review_text:
it no longer feels like a lively shopping mall.
Most of the retail spaces have been converted into corporate offices, and many shops are closed. Because of this, the mall lacks the usual “mall vibes.” Elevators and escalators are inconsistent—sometimes working, sometimes not—which can be inconvenient. Maintenance also seems lacking in certain areas, with low air conditioning and visible wear like peeling paint. Ongoing renovation or dismantling work makes the ambience feel a bit dull and humid.
The Cafe Junction and the food court on the ground floor are decent, offering limited but reasonably priced food options, mainly catering to office-goers. The food quality is good for the price.
The main attraction is Cinepolis (earlier Cinemastar), which has 5 screens. The theatre quality is good, ticket prices are comparatively affordable, and it remains the most active part of the mall. There are also a couple of spas, small offices, and a corporate center with a terrace turf.
The Mahaveer Premium Banquet Hall is well-maintained with good ambience and can accommodate around 250 guests. Food by Mahaveer Caterers is excellent, and the staff is polite and attentive, making it a good choice for events.
Overall, this place is okay for office work, movies, or a quiet visit, but not ideal if you’re looking for shopping or entertainment. Once a buzzing mall, it seems to have lost its charm to bigger malls nearby. An average experience overall.

featured_reviews.name: Debabrata Golder
featured_reviews.review_text:
High Street Mall benefits from a fantastic, easily accessible location, but it unfortunately falls quite short of being a premium shopping or leisure destination due to some significant maintenance and management issues.
On the positive side, the mall does offer some convenient, basic amenities. There is a dedicated parking area, which is always a relief in a busy location. For entertainment and food, it houses a Cinepolis movie theater and a restaurant on the ground floor, so your basic dining and movie options are covered.
However, the overall vibe of the building feels much more like a busy commercial complex than a traditional shopping mall. A large portion of the space seems to be taken up by various businesses, with numerous offices for real estate brokers, loan companies, and call centers.
The biggest drawbacks—and the areas that urgently need attention—are hygiene and safety. The entire mall suffers from a noticeable, unpleasant smell that makes simply walking around quite uncomfortable. Management desperately needs to work on their deep cleaning and air ventilation. Additionally, the security system is surprisingly poor. There isn't a strong, visible security presence or standard crowd-management protocols, which doesn't give you the sense of safety you would expect from a modern commercial space.
Overall, while the great location, parking, and theater make it functional if you have a specific reason to visit, the poor hygiene, lingering bad odor, and weak security make it hard to recommend for a relaxed outing.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Fun Cinemas, located on the 4th floor of K Star Mall in Chembur, offers a standard movie-going experience with some notable positives and areas that could use improvement. One of the standout aspects of this theatre is its diverse language screenings, including Tamil, Malayalam, Telugu, Hindi, and English. This makes it a great option for regional movie lovers in Mumbai who want to catch films in their native language.

The sound and visual quality are commendable, with Dolby Atmos enhancing the audio experience and the screen clarity being satisfactory. These technical aspects ensure that the core movie-watching experience is enjoyable. The theatre is also conveniently located near Diamond Garden and is close to Ghatala railway station, making it easily accessible for locals and commuters.

However, the theatre's location in an old and mostly abandoned mall detracts significantly from the overall experience. The mall feels deserted, especially at night, which creates an eerie and isolated atmosphere. Inside, the seating, although slightly repaired and improved, is still average, with some chairs showing signs of wear and tear. The maintenance of the premises is also below par, with cleanliness in common areas needing much more attention.

The food and beverage options are decent, with the nachos and cool drinks standing out as personal favorites. However, like most multiplexes in Mumbai, the prices are high, which doesn’t always align with the quality or portion sizes. There have also been occasional complaints about stale food, which is disappointing.

In conclusion, Fun Cinemas in K Star Mall is a decent choice if you’re looking to watch movies in regional languages or live nearby. However, the outdated ambiance, maintenance issues, and high prices make it a less appealing option compared to other multiplexes in the city.

Natraj Cinema has upheld this tradition, offering not just movies but an experience that transcends the silver screen.

Natraj Cinema boasts state-of-the-art facilities, including cutting-edge sound systems and high-definition screens, ensuring a top-notch audio-visual experience for its patrons. The cinema's comfortable seating and inviting ambiance create a welcoming atmosphere, making every visit a memorable one.

What sets Natraj Cinema apart is its diverse selection of films. From the latest blockbusters to critically acclaimed independent movies and regional gems, the cinema caters to a wide audience, embracing varied tastes and preferences. Families flock to Natraj Cinema for its family-friendly screenings, creating cherished memories together.

Moreover, Natraj Cinema stands as a cultural beacon, hosting film festivals, premieres, and special events that celebrate the art of cinema. It serves as a platform for budding filmmakers, providing a space where creativity and innovation are nurtured and appreciated.

Beyond its cinematic offerings, Natraj Cinema engages with the community, organizing charity events, fundraisers, and awareness campaigns. The cinema believes in giving back to the society it serves, making a positive impact beyond the realm of entertainment.

In essence, Natraj Cinema is not merely a movie theater; it is a cherished institution that weaves stories, emotions, and togetherness into the fabric of the community. It continues to illuminate the silver screen, bringing joy and entertainment to generations, ensuring that the magic of cinema lives on, one screening at a time.

AC was very powerful, seats very comfortable, picture and sound quality excellent, canteen used to serve tasty samosas, snacks and beverages at reasonable prices. Management was talking pains to maintain the ambience and decor. But over the period, due to poor management, improper maintenance, the quality deteriorated gradually and it has come to the present stage. Added to all these, competition from multiplexes has caused further damage. Most surprising is still it continues to run against all odds is something great. I doubt will there be any scope for improvement. The best option will be to sell the land to some potential builder who can build Shopping mall or residential tower, as the place is strategically located (very close to railway station and bus stop ). Rest is left to God.

featured_reviews.review_text:
📍 Miraj Cinemas Wadala

Miraj Cinemas Wadala is a very good place to watch movies in IMAX and offers one of the best cinema experiences in India. It is known for housing India’s largest IMAX screen, which makes the overall viewing experience truly grand and immersive. The massive screen delivers sharp visuals, vibrant colors, and excellent clarity, making every scene feel larger than life.

I watched Avatar: Fire and Ash here, and the experience was outstanding. The visuals looked absolutely stunning on the huge IMAX screen, and the depth and details of every scene were clearly visible. The powerful sound system made the movie even more immersive, allowing you to feel every background score, action sequence, and dialogue perfectly. Watching a visually rich movie like Avatar in this IMAX theatre truly takes the cinematic experience to another level.

The seating is comfortable and well arranged, providing a clear view of the screen from almost every seat. The ambience of the theatre is modern, clean, and well maintained. Staff members are polite, and entry and exit are well managed. The food and beverage options are good, though slightly expensive, which is expected in an IMAX theatre.

Overall, Miraj Cinemas Wadala is an excellent destination for movie lovers who want to enjoy films in IMAX format. Highly recommended for a premium and memorable movie-watching experience. 🎬🍿

featured_reviews.review_text: Miraj Cinemas Wadala is excellent! 🌟 The "Pop Express" snacks were delightful, and accessing exclusive discounts via QR code was convenient. 🍿 The IMAX experience proved impressive and remarkably comfortable. ✨ The rice ball purchased was satisfactory and offered good value. 🍚

featured_reviews.name: Ashish
featured_reviews.review_text:
I went to watch O'Romeo on Screen 2. There are 4 other screens. This review is not about the largest IMAX screen in dome shaped theatre because mostly English movies are shown in that.
This cinema hall deserves 5 star rating literally considering its overall experience. The ambience is super clean. The washroom area is neat and clean with facilities such as hand drier, napkins stand, liquid hand wash, plants etc. The lighting is superb everywhere in and out. Photogenic space everywhere around with benches, sofas, Chandelier, etc.
The screen size, sound quality, AC temperature, visual quality, cleanliness, etc. everything is top class. I booked recliner seat. It is button operated offering a space to keep the glass and a tray to keep eatables, handkerchief, mobile etc. Ladies purse or totte bag is allowed inside the hall. The staff is polite. The hall is cleaned immediately after the movie is over before the next show.
The food court has a lot of options and considering the quality of ambience and slow relaxing music inside the premises, the pricing is justified.
Free clean drinking water is available with disposable paper cups.
The crowd is also decent.
Generally, the cinema hall is almost empty for most of the Bollywood movies; hence, one can enjoy solitude also many a times.
They appreciate online payments and cards at food courts and booking box office counter. Lot of food options are available such as samosa, nachos, popcorn, pizza, burger, etc.
Frisking process is very smooth.
Valet parking is available.
It is at a walking distance from Bhakti Park Monorail station. There is a metro station under construction nearby.
Beside IMAX, one can enjoy a very clean green 25 acres Bhakti Park.
There is car racing nearby as well.

featured_reviews.name: Jigar Budhdev
featured_reviews.review_text: This is the best IMAX experience in India. The dome shaped structure means you're looking down the screen if you're seated at the back. This really helps. Also, the screen size is the biggest in India so you would enjoy native IMAX content. The sound system is excellent and so is the projection system. The tickets and snacks are reasonably priced. There's ample parking since this is a standalone multiplex and not part of any mall. The only grouse is that to reach the IMAX screen, there's only one elevator and no escalators; just normal stairs.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review to document a serious food safety incident at PVR, Jio World Plaza, BKC.

On 15 January 2026, I attended the 6:00 PM show of Avatar 3 in Audi 6. Before the movie, I purchased food from the PVR counter. While eating it during the show, the final bite contained a visible piece of glass that entered my mouth. I immediately spat it out. The fact that I was not physically injured was purely a matter of luck, this could have caused severe internal injury or worse.

I have video evidence clearly showing the glass shard in the food.

What has been equally disturbing is the way this matter has been handled since. Despite multiple emails, follow-ups, and assurances that the issue was being taken seriously, there were significant delays, inconsistent communication, and ultimately a response stating that no lapse could be established at their end. The only gesture initially offered was complimentary movie tickets, which is entirely inappropriate for a life-threatening food safety incident.

As a paying customer, being exposed to such a risk and then experiencing weeks of delay and deflection has been deeply distressing. This review is being posted so that other patrons are aware and so that this concern is documented publicly after private escalation failed to lead to a responsible resolution.

I hope PVR reviews its food safety accountability and customer handling practices more seriously going forward.

Ticket pricing between ₹250–₹500 feels reasonable considering the cleanliness and comfort, especially if booked smartly on weekdays.

But as usual with PVR, the food pricing is absurd. Ordered a ₹350 Schezwan Paneer Wrap and it was a complete waste of money. The taste was terrible and definitely not worth the price. They serve it properly with a tray, plate, and cutlery, but realistically, how convenient is that setup inside a movie theatre while watching a film in the dark?

Popcorn and drinks are also heavily overpriced, and the quantity doesn’t justify the cost either.

Overall: great theatre experience for seating, cleanliness, and ambience — but avoid spending too much on the food unless you’re okay paying premium prices for average quality.

featured_reviews.name: Dev Sai
featured_reviews.review_text:
My visit to INOX Neelyog in Ghatkopar East was a bit of a mixed experience. While the theatre itself is okay, it feels like a bit of a deserted venue. The mall it’s located in is quite old, and despite being owned by PVR-INOX, the place feels stuck in time, lacking the modern amenities you’d expect from their brand. It doesn’t have the same fresh, updated atmosphere as other PVR-INOX theatres.

Its proximity to the Ghatkopar Railway Station makes it a convenient choice for moviegoers relying on public transport.

The seating was decent, but there was nothing exceptional about it. The overall maintenance seemed lacking, and the place just felt a bit neglected. The staff were polite, but the overall service felt a bit lackluster, especially when compared to other PVR-INOX theatres. The staff seemed understaffed, and there were minor delays in service, particularly at the concession stand. As for maintenance, it was evident that the theatre could use some attention. The cleanliness in the common areas and washrooms was below par, and the seats, though functional, showed signs of wear and tear.

The ticket prices were reasonable, but when compared to other PVR-INOX theatres, this one doesn’t justify the price for the experience it offers. Snacks were also the standard fare, but the portions were smaller, and they didn’t feel as fresh.

In summary, while it wasn’t a terrible experience, it felt more like a theatre stuck in the past, lacking the vibrant and well-maintained vibe you’d expect from a PVR-INOX property. It’s good if you're in the area, but I wouldn’t go out of my way for it.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Movie theatre near Ghatkopar railway station and have some mixed feelings about my experience. The screen size and quality were average, which was a bit disappointing. However, the sound quality was good, which enhanced the overall movie-watching experience.

The biggest issue I faced was the crowd at the lift due to the mandatory security check. It took a long time to get through the line, and it was quite frustrating. I would recommend taking the stairs if your screen is located on a lower level to avoid the crowd and save time.

The chairs were also of average quality, not too comfortable, but not uncomfortable either. However, the air conditioning was good, which made the experience more enjoyable.

Overall, I would say that this movie theatre is a decent option for watching movies, especially if you're in the area. However, it has its drawbacks, such as the average screen size and quality and the crowd at the lift during security check. If you can manage to take the stairs and don't mind the average chair quality, it could be a good option for you.
